intro: Following rumours of a haunted isle off the jungle coast, Baron Revilgaz suspects an ancient troll relic has resurfaced. He directs explorers to scout the mysterious landmass and delivers a pass to research the artifact within the archives of Stormwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If there is indeed a goblin mage and water elementals haunting the island, it could mean the Stone of the Tides can be mine!

I want you to locate this haunted island... Find out what's going on. Oh, and if you perhaps want to find out more about the Stone of the Tides, take this scrip to the Stormwind Library, they should be able to find you a copy of the book I first came across the legend in.
Could it be that Gazban actually discovered the Stone...?

clips.title: Progress
paras: The trolls truly possessed some amazing magical objects, friend. And now, perhaps, I have the opportunity to add one to my extensive collection. Did you have any luck finding the source of the rumor?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the stories were true! Incredible!
However, we will need to figure out a way to defeat the curse of the Stone of the Tides, if we are to retrieve it. The curse is magical business, we'll need one of those wizards to help us out.
